Aisha Khan: Drafting a short customer note for the onboarding tenants affected by yesterday's ingest delay. Sending targeted to high-touch first.

Diego Morales: Please lead with an apology and exact UTC window. Also flag renewal-risk accounts for 1:1.

Aisha Khan: Adding SRE line and window. Draft email: "Hi {{first_name}},
Were sorry  on March 22 between 03:10 and 03:48 UTC some onboarding ingestion jobs for a subset of customers were delayed. We fixed the issue, completed backfills for primary onboarding flows, and added safeguards to prevent recurrence.
What we did: blocked malformed protobufs, rate-limited replays, completed backfills.
What to expect: office hours for affected customers, ingestion overage credits for charges during the outage window, high-touch customers receive a one-month platform credit. Reply to request a 1:1.
Sincerely, Aisha Khan, Customer Success"

Priya Nair: I uploaded the high-touch list: https://redwood-internal/drive/high-touch-onboard-3-22.csv. Sales to follow renewal-risk flags.

Diego Morales: Approve credit wording: "We will credit ingestion overage charges incurred during the outage window; high-touch customers get an additional one-month usage credit."

Aisha Khan: Plan: send targeted now, broadcast after, host two office hours (APAC + EMEA/AMER), attach short RCA, file customer copies on incident page. Thanks all. :heart:
